assignment_algorithm.name: deterministic_largest_block_first_balanced_counts
assignment_algorithm.order_blocks: descending sample count, then ascending sha256 of sorted private member IDs
assignment_algorithm.assign_role: minimum current block count, then minimum current sample count, then fixed role order REF_TRAIN,SOURCE_VALID,SOURCE_TEST

gates.F0: Panel, discovery, metadata, IBD and map identities and counts satisfy the frozen M27E contract.
gates.F1: Every sample receives exactly one role or explicit out-of-scope status; all 128 NatWGS samples and their complete population/IBD closure are DISCOVERY.
gates.F2: No population or frozen primary IBD block crosses roles.
gates.F3: AFR, EUR and NAM each retain at least two blocks in REF_TRAIN, SOURCE_VALID and SOURCE_TEST.
gates.F4: The splitter reads VCF headers only and does not inspect any genotype, rare support, position or LAI result.

next_gate: Mechanically extract DISCOVERY+REF_TRAIN+SOURCE_VALID columns, verify zero SOURCE_TEST IDs, then derive support from the 954 discovery-frozen sites using REF_TRAIN and evaluate it once in SOURCE_VALID.
